top_categories.workout_context: When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
53ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before February.
At mile 60 of 90, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands. Train it until it feels boring.
At Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.

Road-specific control matters at Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 90 miles.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 90 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 90 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,849ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

race_overlay.weather: February in Pombal, Portugal — Central Portugal's coastal-influenced Leiria region; the 2027 edition runs at the end of February. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands’s 90 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 90 miles of mixed terrain in Pombal, Portugal.
